description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2008 World Championships by countering the cards most played there: it shuts off the opponent's Poké-Powers and Poké-Bodies, weakens their Special Energy cards, and punishes them with Scizor for playing those cards. The 2008 World Championships were held at the Hilton Orlando Lake Buena Vista in Orlando, Florida, from 15 to 17 August 2008.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2008 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
